mentions.name: what if… economics
mentions.description: A simple one-page economics simulator that lets users adjust macroeconomic factors such as interest rate, inflation, and unemployment to see their effects, designed to show economic relationships to non-experts.
mentions.problem: There was no simple place to see the effect of changing macroeconomic factors such as interest rate, inflation, and unemployment.
mentions.source_excerpt:
"what if… economics", a simple one-page economics simulator: https://whatifeconomics.com

I wanted to have a place to see the effect of changing macroeconomic factors, e.g. interest rate, inflation, unemployment, etc. It's designed to show economic relationships for non-experts.
mentions.author: tagawa
